document: Passport of a citizen of the Republic of Tajikistan (identity card)
office: the Passport and Registration Service of the Ministry of Internal Affairs

routes.label: at the Passport and Registration Service: up to 15 days

note: The Ministry of Internal Affairs' list of services: the commission for the card is US$10 under Government Resolution No. 336 of 30 May 2014, paid in somoni at the National Bank's rate on the day, and the card is made within 15 days. The list gives no state duty or service charge for the card (it does for the passport for travel abroad), no age from which it is issued and no term; the Law on Identity Documents (2014) that sets them could not be read in full, so every age is offered and the term is null.

sources.title: Ministry of Internal Affairs of the Republic of Tajikistan, List of services of the Passport and Registration Service
sources.said: Passport of a citizen of the Republic of Tajikistan (IC-identity card) ... The cost of one passport form is 10 US dollars when paid in national currency at the rate determined by the National Bank of the Republic of Tajikistan on the day of deposit (by the Resolution of the Government of the Republic of Tajikistan dated May 30, 2014 No. 336, the commission for issuing a passport of a citizen of the Republic of Tajikistan is set at 10 US dollars) - the passport processing period is up to 15 days.
